results.title: Adjustment of the Fee Schedule for Immigration Benefit Requests
results.abstract: The Department of Homeland Security proposes to adjust the fee schedule for certain immigration benefit requests. The proposal would change how fees are set for several forms. Comments are due by the date shown in the notice.

results.title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Revision of a Currently Approved Collection: Application to Register Permanent Residence or Adjust Status (Form I-485)
results.abstract: The Department of Homeland Security invites the general public to comment on a revision of a currently approved information collection for Form I-485 and its supplements. Supplement A and Form I-693 are also affected.

results.title: Extension of the Designation of a Country for Temporary Protected Status
Modernizing Requirements for Students in Practical Training
results.abstract: This final rule amends regulations for F-1 students in optional practical training. It takes effect 30 days after publication.

results.title: Technical Amendments to Procedures for Filing
results.abstract: This rule makes technical corrections to filing procedures. It does not change eligibility.
